title: A method for offloading tasks in Internet of Vehicles based on federated learning

pse.problem: The continuous progress of information technology and wireless communication leads to insufficient resources for task loading in a cloud network for high-quality low-delay communication services.
pse.solution_function: Minimizes processing time delay of vehicle computing tasks and enables the internet of vehicles to obtain an optimal unloading decision under minimum task processing time delay by using a federal learning-based algorithm.
pse.solution_structure: Client-server architecture with two participants: participant vehicle and server, utilizing Double Deep Q Network (DDQN) for dynamic adaptation to the internet of vehicles environment.
pse.solution_implementation: Steps include establishing communication and calculation models between Internet of vehicles and edge servers, introducing DDQN for task unloading decisions, and implementing a federal learning algorithm for Internet of vehicles task offloading.
pse.effect: Reduces energy consumption and time delay by offloading computing tasks from vehicles to edge servers, optimizing resource allocation under the constraint of edge server resource limitations
